title: Same Values, Different Languages? From Multilingual Probing to Steering LLMs Toward Chinese Social Values
abstract: arXiv:2609.08515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into human society, aligning them with pluralistic social values has become a critical priority. However, whether LLMs exhibit consistent value preferences across languages remains underexplored, particularly for culturally grounded values, which are more abstract and difficult to evaluate and align than safety-centric principles. We investigate this issue through Chinese Social Values (CSV), a value system rooted in Chinese culture and comprising $12$ dimensions across national, societal, and personal levels. We construct C-Voices, the first comprehensive multilingual contrastive probe dataset for CSV, with 86,400 dilemma-based instances in six languages, each pairing a CSV-aligned action with a value-conflicting alternative. Building on the contrastive probes of C-Voices, we then propose a fine-tuning-free value vector steering method that derives value directions from hidde

translated_title: 同样的价值观，不同的语言？从多语言探测到引导大语言模型趋向中国社会价值观
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型日益融入人类社会，使其与多元社会价值观保持一致已成为关键优先事项。然而，大语言模型在不同语言中是否表现出一致的价值偏好仍未得到充分探索，尤其是对于具有文化根基的价值观——它们比以安全为核心的原则更加抽象，也更难进行评估和对齐。我们通过中国社会价值观来研究这一问题，这是一套根植于中国文化的价值体系，涵盖国家、社会和个人三个层面的12个维度。我们构建了C-Voices，这是首个面向中国社会价值观的综合性多语言对比探测数据集，包含六种语言的86,400个基于道德困境的实例，每个实例将一个符合中国社会价值观的行为与一个价值冲突的替代选项配对。基于C-Voices的对比探测，我们进一步提出了一种无需微调的价值向量引导方法，该方法从模型隐藏层中提取价值方向……
tldr: 该研究构建了首个多语言中国社会价值观对比探测数据集C-Voices，并提出一种无需微调的价值向量引导方法，用以揭示和纠正大语言模型在不同语言间价值偏好的不一致性。
en_tdlr: This study constructs C-Voices, the first comprehensive multilingual contrastive probe dataset for Chinese Social Values, and proposes a fine-tuning-free value vector steering method to reveal and correct cross-lingual value preference inconsistencies in LLMs.
